golden_cases.description: Grounded NIH NIDDK Q&A synthesis for Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus and Metformin renal eGFR guidelines.
golden_cases.query: What are the clinical evidence guidelines and renal function eGFR thresholds for Metformin therapy in Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (ICD-10 E11.9)?
golden_cases.reference_answer: Metformin biguanide therapy is the first-line pharmacologic treatment for Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (ICD-10: E11.9) per NIDDK guidelines. Renal function monitoring via eGFR is mandatory: Metformin is contraindicated in patients with an eGFR below 30 mL/min/1.73m2 (CKD Stage 4/5) due to the risk of metformin-associated lactic acidosis (MALA), and initiation is not recommended when eGFR is between 30 and 45 mL/min/1.73m2. Temporarily discontinue metformin prior to iodinated contrast imaging procedures [NIH-MEDQUAD-001].

golden_cases.description: Severe Warfarin + Ibuprofen (NSAID) hemorrhagic and renal contraindication in Atrial Fibrillation and CKD Stage 4 triggering Attending Physician HITL escalation.
golden_cases.query: Synthesize anticoagulation management and screen contraindications for Warfarin and Ibuprofen in a patient with Atrial Fibrillation and CKD Stage 4.
golden_cases.reference_answer: Oral anticoagulation with Warfarin in Atrial Fibrillation targets an INR of 2.0-3.0. Concomitant administration of systemic NSAIDs such as ibuprofen with Warfarin in a patient with CKD Stage 4 is strictly CONTRAINDICATED due to synergistic gastrointestinal/intracranial hemorrhage risk and afferent renal arteriolar vasoconstriction precipitating acute renal failure. Avoid systemic NSAIDs completely and escalate to Attending Physician HITL review [NIH-MEDQUAD-004] [NIH-DRUG-002].

golden_cases.reference_answer: Essential hypertension (ICD-10: I10) is defined by NHLBI guidelines as persistent systolic blood pressure >= 130 mmHg or diastolic blood pressure >= 80 mmHg. First-line antihypertensive classes include thiazide diuretics, ACE inhibitors (lisinopril), ARBs (losartan), and calcium channel blockers (amlodipine) [NIH-MEDQUAD-002].

golden_cases.query: What is the medical definition of essential hypertension and staging of essential hypertension in NIH MedQuAD?
golden_cases.reference_answer: Essential hypertension (ICD-10: I10) is defined by NHLBI guidelines as systolic blood pressure >= 130 mmHg or diastolic blood pressure >= 80 mmHg, with Stage 1 spanning 130-139/80-89 mmHg and Stage 2 >= 140/90 mmHg, managed with thiazides, ACE inhibitors, ARBs, or calcium channel blockers [NIH-MEDQUAD-002].

golden_cases.description: Dynamic ModelRouter selecting gemini-2.5-pro for complex Myasthenia Gravis neuromuscular pathophysiology and Fluoroquinolone Boxed Warning contraindication.
golden_cases.query: Synthesize the diagnostic workup and medication contraindications for a patient with Myasthenia Gravis considering Ciprofloxacin or Fluoroquinolones.
golden_cases.reference_answer: Myasthenia Gravis (ICD-10: G70.00) is an autoimmune neuromuscular junction disorder mediated by anti-AChR or anti-MuSK autoantibodies and diagnosed via serology, repetitive nerve stimulation, and SFEMG. Systemic fluoroquinolones (ciprofloxacin) and aminoglycosides carry an FDA Boxed Warning and are strictly CONTRAINDICATED because they impair neuromuscular transmission and precipitate life-threatening myasthenic crisis and respiratory paralysis [NIH-MEDQUAD-003] [NIH-DRUG-003].

golden_cases.description: Grounded NIH GARD rare-disease synthesis for Marfan Syndrome Revised Ghent Nosology and aortic root surveillance.
golden_cases.query: What are the diagnostic criteria under the Revised Ghent Nosology and cardiovascular surveillance protocols for Marfan Syndrome?
golden_cases.reference_answer: Marfan Syndrome (ICD-10: Q87.40) is an autosomal dominant connective tissue disorder caused by FBN1 fibrillin-1 mutations. Diagnosis under the Revised Ghent Nosology requires aortic root dilatation (Z-score >= 2.0) plus ectopia lentis, a pathogenic FBN1 mutation, or systemic score >= 7. Management includes serial echocardiography, beta-blockers or losartan, and prophylactic aortic root replacement at >= 5.0 cm [NIH-MEDQUAD-005].

golden_cases.description: High-Dose Methotrexate pediatric oncology leucovorin rescue protocol and NSAID contraindication screening triggering Attending Oncologist HITL escalation.
golden_cases.query: What safety monitoring, leucovorin rescue, and drug interaction contraindications govern High-Dose Methotrexate and Ibuprofen in pediatric osteosarcoma?
golden_cases.reference_answer: High-Dose Methotrexate (HDMTX) in pediatric osteosarcoma and ALL requires IV hyperhydration, urinary alkalinization (pH >= 7.0), serial serum methotrexate monitoring, and timed leucovorin rescue. Co-administration of NSAIDs (ibuprofen), PPIs, or trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole is strictly CONTRAINDICATED due to renal OAT1/OAT3 inhibition and fatal myelosuppression/renal toxicity, requiring Attending Oncologist HITL review [NIH-MEDQUAD-006] [NIH-DRUG-004].
